- `Basic.doit`
- `Atom.doit`
- `TYPE_CHECKING` `Expr.doit`.
- `TYPE_CHECKING` `TensAdd.doit`.

commits.author: Hunter Hogan
commits.message:
Annotate doit

Basic.doit returns Basic, Atom.doit returns Self, and Expr declares
doit -> Expr. TensAdd declares Expr args so TensAdd.doit type checks.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

diff:
diff --git a/sympy/core/basic.py b/sympy/core/basic.py
index 901fc4773f7a..179ede76f724 100644
--- a/sympy/core/basic.py
+++ b/sympy/core/basic.py
@@ -2067,7 +2067,7 @@ def count_ops(self, visual=False):
         from .function import count_ops
         return count_ops(self, visual)
 
-    def doit(self, **hints):
+    def doit(self, **hints: Any) -> Basic:
         """Evaluate objects that are not evaluated by default like limits,
         integrals, sums and products. All objects of this kind will be
         evaluated recursively, unless some species were excluded via 'hints'
@@ -2408,7 +2408,7 @@ def _xreplace(self, rule: Mapping[Any, Basic]) -> tuple[Basic, bool]:
             return rule[self], True
         return self, False
 
-    def doit(self, **hints):
+    def doit(self, **hints: Any) -> Self:
         return self
 
     @classmethod
diff --git a/sympy/core/expr.py b/sympy/core/expr.py
index 6e38bb28f899..901a960659bb 100644
--- a/sympy/core/expr.py
+++ b/sympy/core/expr.py
@@ -105,6 +105,9 @@ def xreplace(self, rule: Mapping[Tbasic, Basic]) -> Basic:
         def simplify(self, **kwargs) -> Expr:
             ...
 
+        def doit(self, **hints: Any) -> Expr:
+            ...
+
         def evalf(self, n: int | None = 15, subs: dict[Basic, Basic | float] | None = None,
                   maxn: int = 100, chop: bool | int = False, strict: bool  = False,
                   quad: str | None = None, verbose: bool = False) -> Expr:
diff --git a/sympy/tensor/tensor.py b/sympy/tensor/tensor.py
index 65f931b7d35f..e2e3e7fe0132 100644
--- a/sympy/tensor/tensor.py
+++ b/sympy/tensor/tensor.py
@@ -2480,6 +2480,12 @@ class TensAdd(TensExpr, AssocOp):
     [x + 1, y + 2, z + 3, t + 4]
     """
 
+    if TYPE_CHECKING:
+
+        @property
+        def args(self) -> tuple[Expr, ...]:
+            ...
+
     def __new__(cls, *args, **kw_args):
         args = [_sympify(x) for x in args if x]
         args = TensAdd._tensAdd_flatten(args)
